name: raiders-stockade
description: The Raiders' Stockade (story/raiders_stockade), rebuilt from scratch (ROADMAP 49, tools/blueprints/REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes a candidate; loot.py then writes the loot chest's LootTable into the saved .nbt (rebuild.py carries no block-entity data).

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py raiders_stockade raiders_stockade --candidate && python3 loot.py ../../../../build/rebuild/raiders_stockade/raiders_stockade.nbt
